title: Error Index
description: This chapter enumerates each Beskid diagnostic code. Each entry has a description, an example, a platform spec capability reference, and a source file reference. The codes use the E prefix for errors and the W prefix for warnings. The prose conforms to ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.

sections.title: Definition and declaration errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a declaration uses a name twice or refers to an unknown type. The codes use the E1001 to E1006 band.

entries.title: E1001 — Duplicate definition name
entries.description: A type definition uses a name that another definition in the same scope already uses. The compiler rejects the second definition.

entries.title: E1002 — Duplicate enum variant
entries.description: An enum declaration has two variants with the same name. The compiler rejects the duplicate variant.

entries.title: E1003 — Duplicate contract method
entries.description: A contract declaration has two methods with the same name. The compiler rejects the duplicate method.
examples: contract Drawable { unit Draw(); unit Draw(); }

entries.title: E1004 — Conflicting embedded contract method
entries.description: A contract embeds another contract. The embedded contract adds a method that conflicts with an existing method. The compiler rejects the conflict.
examples:
contract A { unit Foo(); }
contract B { : A; unit Foo(); }

entries.title: E1005 — Unknown type in definition
entries.description: A definition refers to a type that the compiler does not know. The compiler rejects the reference.

entries.title: E1006 — Duplicate item name
entries.description: Two top-level items in the same module use the same name. The compiler rejects the second item.

sections.title: Resolution and syntax legality errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a name does not resolve or when the syntax fails a legality check. The codes use the E1101 to E1109 and E1151 to E1154 bands.

entries.title: E1101 — Unknown value
entries.description: A value path does not resolve to a function, a local, a constant, or an enum constructor. The compiler rejects the path.

entries.title: E1102 — Duplicate item or local
entries.description: Two items or two locals in the same scope use the same name. The compiler rejects the duplicate.
examples: unit Main() { let x = 1; let x = 2; }

entries.title: E1104 — Ambiguous import
entries.description: A use declaration refers to a name that two modules export. The compiler cannot pick one. The compiler rejects the import.

entries.title: E1105 — Unknown import path
entries.description: A use declaration refers to a path that the compiler cannot find. The compiler rejects the import.

entries.title: E1106 — Use before declaration
entries.description: A name is used before the declaration of the name. The compiler rejects the use.
examples: unit Main() { return x; } let x = 1;

entries.title: E1107 — Private item in module
entries.description: A module refers to a private item of another module. The compiler rejects the access.

entries.title: E1108 — Unknown module path
entries.description: A path refers to a module that the compiler cannot find. The compiler rejects the path.

entries.title: E1109 — Missing import
entries.description: A name is used but the name is not in scope. The compiler suggests an import that may resolve the name.

entries.title: E1151 — Invalid syntax span
entries.description: A syntax node has a span that does not satisfy the span invariants. The compiler rejects the node.
examples: // internal: a node with a reversed span

entries.title: E1152 — Unresolved value path in syntax
entries.description: A value path does not resolve during the syntax legality pass. The compiler rejects the path.
examples: // internal: a value path that fails legality

entries.title: E1153 — Unresolved type path in syntax
entries.description: A type path does not resolve during the syntax legality pass. The compiler rejects the path.
examples: // internal: a type path that fails legality

entries.title: E1154 — Non-canonical syntax control flow
entries.description: A control-flow structure is not in the canonical form. The compiler rejects the structure.

sections.title: Type system errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a type check fails. The codes use the E1201 to E1227 band.

entries.title: E1201 — Unknown type
entries.description: An expression or a declaration refers to a type that the compiler does not know. The compiler rejects the reference.

entries.title: E1202 — Missing type annotation
entries.description: A let binding or a lambda parameter has no type. The compiler cannot infer the type from the context. The compiler rejects the binding.

entries.title: E1203 — Missing type arguments
entries.description: A generic type is used without type arguments. The compiler rejects the use.

entries.title: E1204 — Generic argument or call arity mismatch
entries.description: A generic use or a call gives the wrong number of arguments. The compiler rejects the use.

entries.title: E1205 — Call argument mismatch
entries.description: A call gives an argument with a type that does not match the parameter type. The compiler rejects the call.

entries.title: E1206 — Type mismatch
entries.description: An expression has a type that does not match the expected type. The compiler rejects the expression.

entries.title: E1207 — Return type mismatch
entries.description: A return statement gives a value with a type that does not match the return type. The compiler rejects the return.

entries.title: E1208 — Non-boolean condition
entries.description: An if or while condition has a type that is not bool. The compiler rejects the condition.

entries.title: E1209 — Invalid binary operation
entries.description: A binary operator is applied to operands of a type that the operator does not support. The compiler rejects the operation.

entries.title: E1210 — Invalid unary operation
entries.description: A unary operator is applied to an operand of a type that the operator does not support. The compiler rejects the operation.

entries.title: E1211 — Unknown struct field
entries.description: A struct literal uses a field that the type does not declare. The compiler rejects the field.

entries.title: E1212 — Missing struct field
entries.description: A struct literal omits a field that the type declares. The compiler rejects the literal.
examples:
type Point { i32 x; i32 y; }
Point { x = 1 }

entries.title: E1213 — Invalid member target
entries.description: A member access reads a field of a value that is not a struct-like type. The compiler rejects the access.

entries.title: E1214 — Immutable assignment
entries.description: An assignment writes to a binding that is not mut. The compiler rejects the assignment.

entries.title: E1215 — Non-iterable for target
entries.description: A for statement iterates over a value that does not satisfy the iterable contract. The compiler rejects the statement.

entries.title: E1216 — Iterable Next arity mismatch
entries.description: The Next method of an iterable has the wrong number of parameters. The compiler rejects the iterable.
examples: // internal: an iterable with a bad Next arity

entries.title: E1217 — Iterable Next return not Option
entries.description: The Next method of an iterable does not return Option<T>. The compiler rejects the iterable.
examples: // internal: an iterable whose Next returns i32

entries.title: E1218 — Iterable Option Some arity mismatch
entries.description: The Some payload of the Next return does not match the element type. The compiler rejects the iterable.
examples: // internal: an iterable with a Some payload mismatch

entries.title: E1219 — Invalid event invocation scope
entries.description: An event is invoked from a method that is not on the declaring type. The compiler rejects the invocation.
examples: // internal: an event invoked from outside its type

entries.title: E1220 — Invalid event capacity
entries.description: An event capacity is not a positive integer. The compiler rejects the capacity.

entries.title: E1221 — Invalid event subscription target
entries.description: An event subscription targets a value that is not an event field. The compiler rejects the subscription.
examples: // internal: a subscription to a non-event field

entries.title: E1222 — Invalid try target
entries.description: The try operator is applied to a value that is not a Result. The compiler rejects the operator.

entries.title: E1223 — Spawn target not fiber compatible
entries.description: A spawn expression targets a callable whose return type the compiler cannot check. The compiler rejects the spawn.

entries.title: E1224 — Join would deadlock
entries.description: A fiber tries to join an ancestor fiber. The join would deadlock. The compiler rejects the join.
examples: // internal: a fiber joining its ancestor

entries.title: E1225 — Stack reference escapes spawn
entries.description: A spawn closure captures a stack reference from the spawning fiber. The reference would escape. The compiler rejects the capture.
examples: unit Main() { let x = 1; spawn { return x; } }

entries.title: E1226 — async keyword reserved
entries.description: The keyword async is reserved. The keyword is not implemented in this language version. The compiler rejects the use.

entries.title: E1227 — await keyword reserved
entries.description: The keyword await is reserved. The keyword is not implemented in this language version. The compiler rejects the use.

sections.title: Enum and match errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a match or an enum construction is not valid. The codes use the E1301 to E1308 band.

entries.title: E1301 — Unknown enum path
entries.description: A pattern or a path refers to an enum variant that the compiler does not know. The compiler rejects the reference.

entries.title: E1302 — Enum constructor arity mismatch
entries.description: An enum constructor gives the wrong number of arguments. The compiler rejects the construction.

entries.title: E1303 — Unqualified enum constructor
entries.description: An enum constructor is used without the enum name. The type is not inferred. The compiler rejects the construction.

entries.title: E1304 — Match non-exhaustive
entries.description: A match expression does not cover all variants of the enum. The compiler rejects the match.

entries.title: E1305 — Match arm type mismatch
entries.description: Two match arms produce values of different types. The compiler rejects the match.

entries.title: E1306 — Duplicate pattern binding
entries.description: A pattern binds the same name twice. The compiler rejects the pattern.

entries.title: E1307 — Pattern arity mismatch
entries.description: A pattern gives the wrong number of subpatterns for the variant. The compiler rejects the pattern.

entries.title: E1308 — Match guard must be boolean
entries.description: A match guard has a type that is not bool. The compiler rejects the guard.
examples: match r { Ok(v) when v => v }

sections.title: Control flow errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a break or continue is used outside a loop. The codes use the E1401 to E1402 band.

entries.title: E1401 — Break outside loop
entries.description: A break statement is used outside a loop. The compiler rejects the statement.

entries.title: E1402 — Continue outside loop
entries.description: A continue statement is used outside a loop. The compiler rejects the statement.

sections.title: Visibility and attribute errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a visibility rule or an attribute target is not valid. The codes use the E1501 to E1511 band.

entries.title: E1501 — Visibility violation on private import
entries.description: A use declaration imports a private item. The compiler rejects the import.

entries.title: E1502 — Visibility module not found
entries.description: A visibility check refers to a module that the compiler cannot find. The compiler rejects the reference.

entries.title: E1505 — File-scoped module not first item
entries.description: A file-scoped module declaration is not the first top-level item. The compiler rejects the declaration.

entries.title: E1506 — Duplicate file-scoped module
entries.description: A file has two file-scoped module declarations. The compiler rejects the second declaration.

entries.title: E1507 — Module declaration forbidden in file-scoped module
entries.description: A file-scoped module file has an extra mod declaration. The compiler rejects the declaration.

entries.title: E1508 — Duplicate attribute declaration target
entries.description: An attribute declaration lists the same target twice. The compiler rejects the duplicate target.

entries.title: E1509 — Unknown attribute declaration target
entries.description: An attribute declaration lists a target kind that the compiler does not know. The compiler rejects the target.

entries.title: E1510 — Attribute target not allowed
entries.description: An attribute is applied to a target that the attribute does not permit. The compiler rejects the application.

entries.title: E1511 — Extend type private member access
entries.description: An extend type tries to read a private member of the receiver type. The compiler rejects the access.
examples: extend type Account { unit Leak() { return balance; } }

sections.title: Contract conformance errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a type does not conform to a contract. The codes use the E1601 to E1607 band.

entries.title: E1601 — Contract method missing implementation
entries.description: A type declares conformance to a contract but does not implement a method of the contract. The compiler rejects the type.
examples:
contract Drawable { unit Draw(); }
type Shape : Drawable { }

entries.title: E1602 — Contract implementation signature mismatch
entries.description: A method that implements a contract method has a signature that does not match the contract. The compiler rejects the method.
examples:
contract C { i32 Foo(); }
type T : C { unit Foo() { } }

entries.title: E1606 — Contract method not found
entries.description: A call targets a contract method that the contract does not declare. The compiler rejects the call.
examples: // internal: a call to a missing contract method

entries.title: E1607 — Invalid conformance target
entries.description: A type declares conformance to a name that is not a contract. The compiler rejects the conformance.

sections.title: Composition and dependency injection errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a host composition is not valid. The codes use the E1701 to E1716 band.

entries.title: E1701 — Composition missing launch host
entries.description: An app project has no launch host entry point. The compiler rejects the project.

entries.title: E1702 — Composition multiple launch hosts
entries.description: A composition has more than one launch host entry point. The compiler rejects the composition.

entries.title: E1703 — Composition dependency cycle
entries.description: Two registrations depend on each other. The cycle has no start. The compiler rejects the composition.
examples: // internal: two registrations that form a cycle

entries.title: E1704 — Composition unresolved inject
entries.description: An inject field asks for a type that no registration provides. The compiler rejects the inject.
examples: // internal: an inject with no provider

entries.title: E1705 — Composition ambiguous inject
entries.description: An inject field asks for a type that more than one registration provides. The compiler cannot pick one. The compiler rejects the inject.
examples: // internal: an inject with two providers

entries.title: E1706 — Composition scoped outside with
entries.description: A scoped service is resolved outside a with scope. The compiler rejects the resolution.
examples: // internal: a scoped resolve with no with scope

entries.title: E1707 — Composition child scope without parent
entries.description: A child scope has no parent in the host scope tree. The compiler rejects the scope.
examples: // internal: a child scope with no parent

entries.title: E1708 — Composition with args mismatch
entries.description: A with statement gives arguments that do not match the scope definition. The compiler rejects the statement.

entries.title: E1709 — Composition launch target not host
entries.description: A launch statement targets a name that is not a host definition. The compiler rejects the launch.

entries.title: E1710 — Composition host in mod project
entries.description: A host definition is used in a compiler mod project. The compiler rejects the definition.
examples: // internal: a host in a mod project

entries.title: E1711 — Composition launch in lib project
entries.description: A launch statement is used in a library project. The compiler rejects the statement.
examples: // internal: a launch in a lib project

entries.title: E1712 — Composition inject on constructor
entries.description: An inject field is declared on a constructor. The compiler rejects the field.
examples: // internal: an inject on a constructor

entries.title: E1713 — Composition override lifetime mismatch
entries.description: A registration override uses a lifetime that does not match the original. The compiler rejects the override.

entries.title: E1714 — Composition invalid scope qualifier
entries.description: An inject uses a scope qualifier that the compiler does not know. The compiler rejects the qualifier.
examples: // internal: an inject with a bad qualifier

entries.title: E1715 — Composition host inheritance cycle
entries.description: A host inherits from itself through a chain of hosts. The compiler rejects the cycle.

entries.title: E1716 — Composition duplicate scope name
entries.description: Two scopes in the merged host scope tree use the same name. The compiler rejects the duplicate.
examples: // internal: two scopes with the same name

sections.title: Project manifest errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a project manifest is not valid. The codes use the E1801 to E1900 band. The errors cover project kind, mod section, template section, link section, and legacy manifest names.

entries.title: E1801 — Mod project must not declare target blocks
entries.description: A mod project declares a target block. The compiler rejects the block. Mod projects are discovered via dependencies and contracts.

entries.title: E1802 — Mod project requires mod block
entries.description: A project uses type = Mod but has no mod block. The compiler rejects the project.

entries.title: E1803 — maxGeneratorRounds must be positive
entries.description: The project.mod.maxGeneratorRounds field is zero or negative. The compiler rejects the value.

entries.title: E1804 — Unknown mod capability
entries.description: The project.mod.capabilities list has a name that is not a known capability. The compiler rejects the name.

entries.title: E1805 — Unknown artifact policy
entries.description: The project.mod.artifactPolicy field has a value that is not reuse, rebuild, or clean_rebuild. The compiler rejects the value.
examples: myapp { type = Mod; mod { artifactPolicy = bogus } }

entries.title: E1806 — Generated output layout invalid
entries.description: A project.mod.generatedOutput has an empty layout or a root that is absolute or has a parent directory. The compiler rejects the output.
examples: myapp { type = Mod; mod { generatedOutput { layout = ""; root = "/abs" } } }

entries.title: E1807 — Unsupported project type
entries.description: The project.type field has a value that is not Host, Mod, Template, Aggregate, or Bsol. The compiler rejects the value.

entries.title: E1820 — Mod project does not declare target
entries.description: A build of a mod project passes a target name. The compiler rejects the target. Omit the target flag for mod artifacts.

entries.title: E1872 — maxGeneratorRounds not an integer
entries.description: The project.mod.maxGeneratorRounds or maxMetaRounds field is not a positive integer. The compiler rejects the value.

entries.title: E1873 — Capabilities not a list
entries.description: The project.mod.capabilities field is not a list of names. The compiler rejects the value.

entries.title: E1874 — Mod block only allowed when type is Mod
entries.description: A project that is not a mod project has a mod block. The compiler rejects the block.

entries.title: E1875 — Artifact policy not a string
entries.description: The project.mod.artifactPolicy field is not a single identifier or a quoted string. The compiler rejects the value.

entries.title: E1876 — Corelib opt-out forbidden
entries.description: The manifest declares noCorelib or sets useCorelib to false. The compiler rejects the declaration. Host projects always resolve corelib through the toolchain.

entries.title: E1877 — Template project cannot be built
entries.description: A build targets a template project. The compiler rejects the build. Use beskid new to instantiate the template first.

entries.title: E1878 — Template project must not declare target
entries.description: A template project declares a target block. The compiler rejects the block. Template packages are not host compile roots.

entries.title: E1879 — Template block only allowed when type is Template
entries.description: A project that is not a template project has a template block. The compiler rejects the block.

entries.title: E1885 — Unknown template field
entries.description: A template block has a field that is not shortName or identity. The compiler rejects the field.

entries.title: E1886 — Bsol project must not declare target blocks
entries.description: A bsol project declares a target block. The compiler rejects the block. Bsol packages are schema-only and are not compile roots.

entries.title: E1887 — Bsol project requires schemas block
entries.description: A project uses type = Bsol but has no schemas block. The compiler rejects the project.

entries.title: E1888 — Bsol project cannot be built
entries.description: A build targets a bsol project. The compiler rejects the build. Use beskid validate-bsol instead.

entries.title: E1890 — Duplicate link block
entries.description: A project manifest has two link blocks at the top level. The compiler rejects the second block.

entries.title: E1892 — Empty entry in link list
entries.description: A link.libraries, link.searchPaths, or link.extraArgs entry is empty. The compiler rejects the entry.

entries.title: E1893 — Duplicate library name
entries.description: The link.libraries list has two entries with the same name. The compiler rejects the duplicate.

entries.title: E1894 — Legacy project block or file name
entries.description: The manifest uses a legacy project block or the legacy Project.proj file name. The compiler rejects the legacy form. Use a named root block and a .bproj file.

entries.title: E1895 — Legacy workspace file name
entries.description: The workspace uses the legacy Workspace.proj file name. The compiler rejects the legacy form. Use a .bws workspace manifest.

entries.title: E1896 — Project root block kind must match name
entries.description: The root block kind does not match the project name. The compiler rejects the mismatch.

entries.title: E1897 — Aggregate project does not declare target
entries.description: A build of an aggregate project passes a target name. The compiler rejects the target. Omit the target flag for aggregate projects.

entries.title: E1900 — Schemas block only allowed when type is Bsol
entries.description: A project that is not a bsol project has a schemas block. The compiler rejects the block.

sections.title: Mod host errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a mod host registration or a scheduling step is not valid. The codes use the E1828 to E1832 and E1851 to E1855 bands. The errors do not carry Beskid source spans.

entries.title: E1828 — Missing entry symbol
entries.description: A mod registration refers to an entry symbol that is empty or missing. The compiler rejects the registration.
examples: // mod descriptor with an empty entrySymbol

entries.title: E1829 — Duplicate registration in artifact
entries.description: One mod artifact declares the same contract and type pair twice. The compiler rejects the duplicate.
examples: // mod descriptor with a duplicate (contractId, typeId)

entries.title: E1830 — Empty registrations for required mod
entries.description: A mod package declares required contracts but its registrations array is empty. The compiler rejects the package.
examples: // mod manifest with required contracts but no registrations

entries.title: E1831 — Missing capability
entries.description: A mod registration is missing a required capability. The compiler rejects the registration.
examples: // mod registration without a required capability

entries.title: E1832 — Max generator rounds exceeded
entries.description: The mod host exceeded the maxGeneratorRounds limit while it merged generated syntax. The compiler rejects the merge.
examples: // mod host that loops past the round limit

entries.title: E1851 — Conflicting registration across artifacts
entries.description: Two mod artifacts provide the same contract and type pair. The host must not pick a winner. The compiler rejects the conflict.
examples: // two mods that register the same (contractId, typeId)

entries.title: E1852 — Duplicate entry symbol across artifacts
entries.description: Two mod artifacts export the same entry symbol for different contract and type pairs. The loader cannot pick one. The compiler rejects the conflict.
examples: // two mods that export the same entrySymbol

entries.title: E1853 — Unknown contract id
entries.description: A mod registration uses a contract id that is not a known SDK contract. The compiler rejects the registration.
examples: // mod registration with an unknown contractId

entries.title: E1854 — Rewriter without analyzer
entries.description: A mod registers a Rewriter but provides no Analyzer to drive it. The compiler rejects the registration.
examples: // mod with a Rewriter but no Analyzer

entries.title: E1855 — Scheduling failure
entries.description: A mod host scheduling step fails and no narrower code in the E1851 to E1870 band applies. The compiler rejects the step.
examples: // mod host scheduling that fails with no narrower cause

sections.title: Macro errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a macro invocation or a macro definition is not valid. The codes use the E1901 to E1908 band.

entries.title: E1901 — Unknown macro
entries.description: A macro invocation uses a name that the compiler does not know. The compiler rejects the use.

entries.title: E1902 — Macro argument arity mismatch
entries.description: A macro invocation gives the wrong number of arguments. The compiler rejects the use.

entries.title: E1903 — Macro argument kind mismatch
entries.description: A macro argument does not match the fragment kind of the parameter. The compiler rejects the use.

entries.title: E1904 — Macro metavariable outside body
entries.description: A metavariable is used outside a macro definition body. The compiler rejects the use.

entries.title: E1905 — Macro expansion depth exceeded
entries.description: A macro expansion goes deeper than the max depth of 32. The compiler rejects the expansion.
examples: // recursive macro that exceeds the depth cap

entries.title: E1907 — Macro ambiguous name
entries.description: Two macro definitions in the same scope use the same name. The compiler cannot pick one. The compiler rejects the invocation.
examples:
macro Foo(expr e) { }
macro Foo(expr e) { }

entries.title: E1908 — Macro duplicate parameter
entries.description: A macro definition has two parameters with the same name. The compiler rejects the definition.

sections.title: Query errors
sections.description: These errors fire when a semantic query exceeds its bounds or hits a pipeline conflict. The codes use the E1880 to E1884 band.

entries.title: E1880 — Query bounds exceeded
entries.description: A query traversal goes past the max nodes or the max depth. The compiler rejects the traversal.
examples: // internal: a query that exceeds its bounds

entries.title: E1881 — Query node span unavailable
entries.description: A query asks for the span of a node that has no span in the current syntax generation. The compiler rejects the request.
examples: // internal: a span request on a spanless node

entries.title: E1883 — Query pipeline conflict
entries.description: A query pipeline has two operations that conflict for one target. The compiler rejects the pipeline.
examples: // internal: a pipeline with conflicting operations

entries.title: E1884 — Query pipeline stale generation
entries.description: A query pipeline references a syntax generation that is no longer current. The compiler rejects the reference.
examples: // internal: a pipeline that holds a stale generation

sections.title: Project IO, lockfile, and materialization errors
sections.description: These errors fire when the compiler reads or writes a manifest, a lockfile, or a materialized dependency. The codes use the E3001 to E3031 band.

entries.title: E3001 — Project file not found
entries.description: The compiler cannot find a project file at the given path. The compiler rejects the build.

entries.title: E3002 — Read manifest failed
entries.description: The compiler cannot read the manifest file. The read fails. The compiler rejects the build.
examples: // manifest file with no read permission

entries.title: E3003 — Manifest parse error
entries.description: The manifest file has a syntax error. The compiler rejects the parse.

entries.title: E3004 — Manifest validation error
entries.description: The manifest passes the parse but fails a validation rule. The compiler rejects the manifest.

entries.title: E3005 — Target not found
entries.description: A build asks for a target name that the manifest does not declare. The compiler rejects the build.

entries.title: E3006 — Dependency manifest not found
entries.description: A dependency refers to a manifest path that the compiler cannot find. The compiler rejects the dependency.
examples: // dependency with a missing manifest path

entries.title: E3007 — Dependency cycle
entries.description: Two or more dependencies form a cycle. The compiler rejects the cycle.
examples: // dependencies that depend on each other

entries.title: E3008 — Unresolved external dependencies
entries.description: One or more external dependencies have no resolution. The compiler rejects the build.
examples: // dependency with no registry or git source

entries.title: E3011 — Unsupported dependency source in v1
entries.description: A dependency uses a source kind that the v1 resolver does not support. The compiler rejects the dependency.
examples: // dependency with an unsupported source kind

entries.title: E3020 — Lockfile read failed
entries.description: The compiler cannot read the lockfile. The read fails. The compiler rejects the build.

entries.title: E3021 — Lockfile write failed
entries.description: The compiler cannot write the lockfile. The write fails. The compiler rejects the build.

entries.title: E3022 — Lockfile out of date
entries.description: The lockfile does not match the manifest. The compiler rejects the build. Update the lockfile first.
examples: // lockfile that is older than the manifest

entries.title: E3023 — Lockfile frozen or required
entries.description: The lockfile update is forbidden in frozen mode, or the lockfile is required in locked mode. The compiler rejects the build.

entries.title: E3030 — Materialization directory or metadata failed
entries.description: The compiler cannot create a materialization directory, read the directory, or read the metadata. The compiler rejects the build.
examples: // materialization target with no write permission

entries.title: E3031 — Materialization copy failed
entries.description: The compiler cannot copy a dependency source into the materialization directory. The compiler rejects the build.
examples: // dependency source that cannot be copied

sections.title: Warnings
sections.description: These warnings fire when the code is valid but has a style, naming, or documentation problem. The codes use the W prefix. Warnings do not stop the build.

entries.title: W1103 — Shadowed local
entries.description: A local binding shadows a local in an outer scope. The compiler warns about the shadow.

entries.title: W1110 — Missing import ambiguous
entries.description: A name is not in scope. The compiler found more than one candidate import. The compiler warns about the candidates.

entries.title: W1203 — Implicit numeric cast
entries.description: An expression does an implicit numeric cast between two types. The compiler warns about the cast.

entries.title: W1403 — Unreachable code
entries.description: A statement comes after a return, a break, or a continue. The code cannot run. The compiler warns about the code.

entries.title: W1503 — Unused import
entries.description: A use declaration imports a name that the file does not use. The compiler warns about the import.

entries.title: W1504 — Unused private item
entries.description: A private item is declared but never used. The compiler warns about the item.

entries.title: W1610 — Doc unknown arg name
entries.description: A doc comment has an @arg tag with a name that does not match a parameter. The compiler warns about the tag.

entries.title: W1611 — Doc duplicate arg name
entries.description: A doc comment has two @arg tags with the same name. The compiler warns about the duplicate.

entries.title: W1612 — Doc arg or returns on non-callable
entries.description: A doc comment has an @arg or @returns tag on an item that is not a function, a method, or a contract method. The compiler warns about the tag.

entries.title: W1613 — Doc returns on unit
entries.description: A doc comment has an @returns tag on a callable that returns unit. The tag is redundant. The compiler warns about the tag.

entries.title: W1614 — Doc unknown directive
entries.description: A doc comment has a directive that the compiler does not know. The compiler warns about the directive.

entries.title: W1615 — Doc unresolved ref
entries.description: A doc comment has an @ref tag that does not resolve. The compiler warns about the reference.

entries.title: W1620 — Doc variant on non-enum
entries.description: A doc comment has an @variant tag on an item that is not an enum. The compiler warns about the tag.

entries.title: W1621 — Doc unknown variant name
entries.description: A doc comment has an @variant tag with a name that does not match a variant of the enum. The compiler warns about the tag.

entries.title: W1622 — Doc duplicate variant name
entries.description: A doc comment has two @variant tags with the same name. The compiler warns about the duplicate.

entries.title: W1623 — Doc par without generics
entries.description: A doc comment has an @par tag on an item that has no generic parameters. The compiler warns about the tag.

entries.title: W1624 — Doc unknown generic name
entries.description: A doc comment has an @par tag with a name that does not match a generic parameter. The compiler warns about the tag.

entries.title: W1625 — Doc duplicate generic name
entries.description: A doc comment has two @par tags with the same name. The compiler warns about the duplicate.

entries.title: W1630 — Type name not PascalCase
entries.description: A type name does not use PascalCase. The compiler warns about the name.

entries.title: W1631 — Enum variant not PascalCase
entries.description: An enum variant does not use PascalCase. The compiler warns about the name.

entries.title: W1632 — Field not camelCase
entries.description: A field does not use lowerCamelCase. The compiler warns about the name.

entries.title: W1633 — Callable not PascalCase
entries.description: A function or a method does not use PascalCase. The compiler warns about the name.

entries.title: W1634 — Module segment not PascalCase
entries.description: A module path segment does not use PascalCase. The compiler warns about the segment.

entries.title: W1635 — Generic parameter not PascalCase
entries.description: A generic type parameter does not use PascalCase. The compiler warns about the name.

entries.title: W1636 — Binding not camelCase
entries.description: A local binding does not use lowerCamelCase. The compiler warns about the name.

entries.title: W1637 — Test not snake_case
entries.description: A test name does not use snake_case. The compiler warns about the name.

entries.title: W1638 — Macro not camelCase
entries.description: A macro name does not use lowerCamelCase. The compiler warns about the name.

entries.title: W1639 — Redundant enum constructor parens
entries.description: A nullary enum constructor has empty parentheses. The parentheses are redundant. The compiler warns about the parens.
